back.en: Study of the composition, structure, properties and changes of matter
back.bm: Kajian komposisi, struktur, sifat dan perubahan jirim

back.en: Pharmacist, chemical engineer, forensic scientist, food technologist, doctor, chemistry teacher
back.bm: Ahli farmasi, jurutera kimia, saintis forensik, teknologis makanan, doktor, guru kimia

back.en: Palm oil (oleochemicals), rubber products, petroleum and petrochemicals, pharmaceuticals
back.bm: Minyak sawit (oleokimia), produk getah, petroleum dan petrokimia, farmaseutikal

back.en: Observation: what you sense directly. Inference: an early explanation of it
back.bm: Pemerhatian: yang dikesan secara langsung. Inferens: penerangan awal tentangnya

back.en: Honest, careful, systematic, curious, cooperative, record data accurately
back.bm: Jujur, berhati-hati, sistematik, ingin tahu, bekerjasama, merekod data dengan tepat

back.en: Lab coat, safety goggles, gloves, closed shoes, face mask
back.bm: Kot makmal, gogal keselamatan, sarung tangan, kasut tertutup, topeng muka

back.en: Neutralise with sodium hydrogen carbonate powder, then wipe with plenty of water
back.bm: Neutralkan dengan serbuk natrium hidrogen karbonat, kemudian lap dengan banyak air

back.en: Cover with sulfur powder; collect with a dropper; never vacuum it
back.bm: Tutup dengan serbuk sulfur; kumpul dengan penitis; jangan sedut dengan vakum

back.en: Rinse under running water for at least 10 minutes and tell the teacher
back.bm: Bilas di bawah air paip sekurang-kurangnya 10 minit dan beritahu guru

back.en: Used for reactions that give off toxic or irritating gases (Cl₂, Br₂, NO₂)
back.bm: Untuk tindak balas yang membebaskan gas toksik atau merengsa (Cl₂, Br₂, NO₂)

back.en: Never pour into the sink; use labelled waste bottles (organic / heavy metal)
back.bm: Jangan tuang ke sinki; guna botol sisa berlabel (organik / logam berat)
